paragraphs.body: Yahoo Sports reports that Jayson Tatum continues to make history in the early going for the Boston Celtics. NBC Sports notes he scored a game-high 32 points against the Orlando Magic. FantasyPros highlights that Tatum flirted with a triple-double in Friday's win over the Chicago Bulls. MassLive and Reuters both confirm Tatum led the Celtics past the Orlando Magic for their fifth straight win, with GMA Network repeating this coverage. Yahoo Sports also mentions that the Brooklyn Nets remain haunted by the 2013 trade that resulted in Tatum joining the Celtics.

headline: Jayson Tatum leads Celtics to fifth straight win with 32 points and near triple-double as Nets remain haunted by his 2013 trade.
